newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS END STEADY AS BLUE CHIPS LOSE.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS END STEADY AS BLUE CHIPS LOSE.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed steady as losses by financial, food and cement scrips overwhelmed the gains by majority of shares ahead of weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index dropped 0.25 points or 0.026 percent to 952.38 on turnover of 42.6 million taka. Gainers led losers by 72 to 55 with five unchanged.

"Losses by blue chips pulled down the index despite gains by majority shares," said one broker. Brokers said cement and financial shares fell on profit taking while food shares lost after European Union banned shrimp imports. Amam Seafood lost 208 to 2,656 and Chittagong Cement fell 12.99 taka to 1,549.48
